clauses.quote: A unit member who receives a sabbatical leave approval shall receive his/her regular salary less 83% of Class I, Step 1.
clauses.subject_text: A unit member who receives a sabbatical leave approval

clauses.quote: The unit member may elect to continue the maintenance of his/her benefits or receive that amount paid by the District for his/her benefits as salary.

Compensation for any employment accepted as part of the sabbatical leave program must not exceed the difference between the regular salary the employee would have received had he/she remained on duty and the salary he/she receives for sabbatical leave.
clauses.subject_text: Compensation for any employment accepted as part of the sabbatical leave program
clauses.notes: Inanimate subject; duty operates on the District's payment limits.

clauses.quote: Sabbatical leaves shall count as a regular period of service
Sabbatical leaves shall not interrupt the unit member's progress on the salary schedule.

Compensation granted by the Board of Education to the employee on leave may be paid in two equal annual installments during the first two years of service rendered in the employ of the District following the return of the employee from the leave of absence (Education Code, Section 44969)
clauses.subject_text: Compensation granted by the Board of Education to the employee on leave
clauses.notes: Passive construction; grants district discretion to structure payment schedule.
